configuration: 8 KB I + 8 KB D, x87 disabled, PC98_MODE enabled
local_changes: PC-98 cache address policy honoring configured RAM size
registered demand request stage in PC98 mode
preread forwarded GPR operands for the barrel shifter
parallel byte segment-limit comparison and combinational endpoint equality
select chain address before late fault qualification, retaining actual issue/start fault gates
precompute normal/redirected prefetch windows before final late-flush selection, no new cycles
resolve load forwarding and partial-register merges per GPR before read selection, with prior reader equivalence checks
PC98 empty-pipe ROM launches use the registered D1 skeleton, adding one launch cycle
PC98 entry ROM reads a registered opcode/prefix tag and waits for the matching result instead of routing speculative next-window decode into M10K
PC98 memory ModR/M EAs always stage base/index before displacement/segment relocation, with live-address equivalence assertion
optional bank-aware upper conventional instruction cache, direct-store line invalidation, and speculative-fetch discard on full cache invalidation
PC98 runtime Full/60/30/15 execution-rate selections using upstream cpu_throttle; actual host clock propagated from SYSFREQ
Preserve visible real-mode CS across CR0.PE transitions; track entry CPL0 until CS reload, fixing HIMEMX block-resize corruption.
Commit the successor VIPT load WB after older hardwired-load memory tokens (write and forward priority); fixes mov r,[m] followed by add r,[m] keeping the MOV value (PC-98 Doom R_PrecacheLevel).

Deferred memory/shift GPR tokens stop committing and forwarding once a younger load WB has written their register or a younger RMW-fast step replaced OPR_R (they still recommit through stalls to deliver late OPR_R data, e.g. POP).

A VIPT EX op whose destination is the register of a deferred memory token whose optimistic (DLY grace) read missed (mem_opt_wait) is routed to the slow path instead of capturing stale OPR_R (mov eax,[uncached]; and eax,[m]).
